# Assessment Supplementary Documents

This directory contains supplementary architecture and application-facts documents generated for the PhotoGallery assessment.

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | Application layers, technologies, and component relationships. |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Declared NuGet dependencies, functional groupings, and compatibility observations. |
| [API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | MVC actions, service catalog, and communication patterns. |
| [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](data-architecture.md) | Blob storage boundary, data ownership, and persistence strategy. |
| [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Runtime/build settings, profiles, and secret provisioning observations. |
| [Core Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | Gallery browsing, upload, and deletion workflows. |
